spiceVersion.description: Manifest schema version. Thumper refuses a manifest with a spiceVersion it doesn't know, rather than guessing.

id.description: Globally unique, lowercase, stable forever. Must equal the Mods/<id>/ folder name.

kind.description: client-only: never affects simulated state, the wire format, or Data/Tweak/*; no online handshake needed. content: does at least one of those; every peer in an online match must have a matching content hash.

unsafe.description: Deep Desert: raw memory read/write and calling game functions from wum.unsafe.*, client VM only. Shown to the user on enable.

network.description: Reserved for a later milestone (Oasis). Accepted and ignored, with a warning, by this build's Thumper.

client.description: Path, relative to the mod folder, loaded into the always-on Sandbox VM.

sim.description: Path registered into the match VM at match start. Requires kind: "content".

include.description: Glob list of files that feed the online content hash. Never computed for a client-only mod.

messages.description: Engine message names this mod registers (content mods only). Checked against the live vanilla registry at start-up, not against a fixed list here; a name that collides is skipped and logged.

weapons.description: Weapon clones (content mods only). At most 3 across all enabled mods, in the free panel cells.

name.description: Resource name of the clone; not a vanilla name, not kWeaponCluster* or kWeaponFactory*.

cell.description: Panel cell; default: the first free cell.

bank.description: A .xom bank under assets/data/ holding a container named `name`.

set.description: Container fields by schema name, with values of the field's type.

weaponText.description: New panel name and help text for vanilla weapons (content mods only). Display only: the simulation is untouched. A key may not be a clone name declared by any mod, and a weapon renamed by an earlier mod refuses the later mod. Applies only in a live content match that every peer has with the same text.

help.description: The panel help text (printable ASCII); one line.

weaponIcons.description: New panel and/or HUD icon for vanilla weapons (content mods only). Presentation only: the simulation is untouched. A key may not be a clone name declared by any mod, and a weapon an earlier mod already has icons for refuses the later mod. Applies only in a live content match that every peer has with the same rules.

panelIcon.description: A square PNG (side a multiple of 64, up to 4096) under the assets root, relative with no '..'. Written over the weapon's own panel sub-icon.

hudIcon.description: A .tga file name in assets/loose/ named <id>.*; loaded in place of the weapon's vanilla HUD icon.

vehicleMeshes.description: The mesh the Airstrike helicopter and the Super Airstrike's are drawn with (content mods only; the mod must also list the bank in "meshes"). The value is a "<modId>.<Name>" mesh from one of the mod's banks. Presentation only: the simulation is untouched. A vehicle an earlier mod already sets refuses the later mod. Applies only in a live content match that every peer has with the same rules. The mesh must keep the vanilla mesh's node names (rear_rotor, top_rotor, trail1, trail2) and animation channels. See docs/meshes.md.

BomberHelicopter.description: The mesh the Airstrike's helicopter is drawn with.

SuperAirstrike.description: The mesh the Super Airstrike's helicopter is drawn with.

levels.description: Map pack levels (content mods only). Built files live in assets/levels/ as <prefix>_<slug>.*, where the prefix is the mod id with '-' replaced by '_'. At most 128 levels across all enabled mods.

slug.description: Unique in the mod; the level stem is <prefix>_<slug>.

title.description: The name shown in the level list (printable ASCII).

type.description: Multiplayer (Versus) levels only in this version.

chunk.description: True when the pack ships assets/levels/<stem>.lub; the level's scripts become stdvs,wormpot,<stem>.

source.description: The erg-patch file the level was built from, relative to the mod folder.

survivor.description: Also list the level as a Survivor copy (Multi.<stem>.S: type 3, unlocked, in the Prebuilt section, running Survivor and the level's chunk).

sim.description: The level's sandboxed script (sim/<name>.lua, at most 256 KB, UTF-8 without a BOM). It runs only on this level, as a sim mod does.

schemes.description: Game styles (the Game Style list in the local modes), allowed for client-only mods. Each file is a scheme: key, title, base, lock, fields and weapons. At most 32 across all enabled mods.

file.description: A .json path relative to the mod folder, inside it (no '..').

factoryWeapons.description: Custom-weapon presets for the team editor, allowed for client-only mods. Each file is a preset: key, title, base, stock, weapon and cluster. At most 64 across all enabled mods.

file.description: A .json path relative to the mod folder, inside it (no '..').

music.description: MP3 tracks for a music slot, allowed for client-only mods (the music is local). Only the suddenDeath slot exists. MPEG-1/2 Layer II or III; all tracks of a slot need the same sample rate and channel count. At most 64 across all enabled mods. The plugin author must hold the rights to the audio.

slot.description: The music slot to play the track in.

file.description: An .mp3 path relative to the mod folder, inside it (no '..'), at most 24 MiB.

title.description: Printable ASCII, shown in the log.

credit.description: The original title or author, shown in the log only.

meshes.description: Mesh banks (.xom, built with xomtool convert --bundle) loaded into the game's graphical resource manager at the main menu, so a weapon clone's set or wum.sim.weapon():set can name a mesh as "<modId>.<Name>". kind: content only. Every resource name in a bank must start with "<modId>.". Each file must be under the mod's assets root, so it is part of the content hash. See docs/meshes.md.

file.description: A .xom path relative to the mod folder, under the assets root (default "assets/"; no '..').

settings.description: Drives wum.config and the Mods page's per-mod settings widgets.

defaultEnabled.description: Honoured only the first time Thumper sees this mod id. Shipped samples set this to false.

depString.description: A mod id, optionally followed by a semver comparator, e.g. 'thumper-extras >= 1.2.0'.
